Name: Voice of the Customer (VOC) Survey Management
Description:
Manages the end-to-end lifecycle of Voice of the Customer surveys, including metadata configuration, invitation distribution, and response tracking. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Configures survey metadata, questions, and active waves.
* Automates the distribution and resending of survey invitations to targeted participants.
* Captures and enriches survey responses with additional contextual information.
* Calculates survey response rates and participation metrics.
* Provides analytical dashboards for tracking survey uptake and customer feedback.
Primary Objects: SurveyInvitation, Survey_Additional_Info__c, Wave__c, Survey_Automation__c, Dashboard_Configuration__c, Survey_Question_Additional_Info__c, Survey_Question_Response_Additional_Info__c, Question_Title__c, Survey_Type__c

Name: VOC Consent and Follow-Up Interview Management
Description:
Manages respondent consent and orchestrates follow-up interviews based on survey feedback. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Tracks and manages customer opt-in and consent for surveys.
* Automatically generates follow-up interview records based on specific survey responses.
* Synchronizes customer roles and populates consent fields dynamically.
* Sends automated email alerts to managers for follow-up interviews.
* Provides a dedicated interface for managing follow-up discussions and interview responses.
Primary Objects: Contact_Consent__c, Interview_Question__c, Interview_Question_Response__c, Interview_Response__c, Interview_Question_Choice__c, Interview__c

Name: Experience Cloud Portal Management
Description:
Provides the foundational infrastructure, authentication, and user experience for public-facing sites and Experience Cloud portals. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Manages user authentication, login forms, and secure access redirection.
* Provides self-registration capabilities with dynamic data capture.
* Supports password recovery and profile management for portal users.
* Renders standardized site templates, headers, and footers for consistent branding.
* Displays custom error pages (e.g., 404 Not Found, Maintenance, Unauthorized, Bandwidth Exceeded).

Name: Approval Workflow Management
Description:
Facilitates the review and processing of pending approval requests within the system. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Provides a centralized dashboard for users to view pending items requiring their approval.
* Allows users to approve or reject records with custom comments.
* Implements specialized approval and rejection overrides for specific events (e.g., Veeva EM Events).

Name: Event Budget Monitoring
Description:
Monitors event budgets and triggers automated alerts based on expense thresholds. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Tracks actual expenses against total allocated event budgets.
* Sends automated email notifications when expenses reach 75% of the budget.
* Sends automated email notifications when expenses reach 90% of the budget.

Name: Territory and Customer Intelligence
Description:
Provides field users with actionable insights, territory planning tools, and customer profiles through specialized dashboards. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Displays territory-level intelligence and performance metrics.
* Provides customer profile insights and medical pipeline data.
* Supports cycle plan actions and pre-call preparation workflows.
* Integrates Veeva Link insights for enhanced territory and profile visibility.

Name: Integration Log Management
Description:
Maintains system health by managing and archiving integration logs. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Identifies integration log records that exceed a specified retention period.
* Automatically deletes outdated logs to optimize storage and system performance.

Name: Apex Trigger Administration
Description:
Provides administrative tools for managing and generating system triggers. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Identifies Salesforce objects that lack specific required triggers.
* Programmatically generates and deploys trigger code from predefined templates.

Name: Veeva CRM Call Report Embedding
Description:
Integrates external Veeva CRM call reporting interfaces directly into the Salesforce environment. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Authenticates and loads external AngularJS-based resources from Veeva servers.
* Renders the Veeva CRM Call Report interface within standard Salesforce page layouts.

Name: Task Management
Description:
Automates the categorization and display of user tasks. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically updates the Record Type of tasks based on specific subject criteria (e.g., HCP contact requests).
* Renders standard task detail views and manages the display of task-related lists and buttons.

Name: Haystack Integration & Signal Management
Description:
Integrates Veeva CRM with the external Haystack platform to synchronize patient and HCP diagnostic signals and manage territory alignments. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Synchronizes patient clinical signals with verified HCP and Treating Site accounts.
* Routes signal record ownership based on territory alignment and geographic data.
* Automatically generates and assigns Veeva Suggestions for medical and sales representatives based on incoming signals.
* Updates 'Rare Sales' and 'TTR Sales' flags on US Person Accounts based on signal data.
* Provides a REST API endpoint for external systems to bulk upsert records into the staging object.

Name: EPPV & PI Call Objective Management
Description:
Automates the lifecycle, scheduling, and tracking of Early Post-Marketing Phase Vigilance (EPPV) and Product Information (PI) Call Objectives. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically creates and schedules Call Objectives for Business Event Targets.
* Closes uncompleted Call Objectives when a related Business Event Target is stopped.
* Manages the deletion of Business Event Targets and prevents deletion if associated Call Objectives are completed.
* Automates the completion and cancellation of EPPV and PI Call Objectives upon Call submission.
* Sends automated daily notifications and warnings for active Call Objectives approaching deadlines.
* Generates EPPV Hospital Progress Reports to track target hospitals and completed call objectives.
* Reassigns ownership of Call Objectives during EPPV events when the current owner loses territory access.

Name: OneTrust Consent Integration
Description:
Integrates Veeva CRM with OneTrust to synchronize data privacy consent and opt-in/opt-out preferences. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Synchronizes Multichannel Consent record creation and updates with OneTrust via asynchronous callouts.
* Updates the related Account's consent status field when a Multichannel Consent record is modified.
* Synchronizes Person Account creation and email updates with OneTrust to maintain accurate consent profiles.

Name: Product Metrics & PDRP Cleansing
Description:
Manages Product Metrics data and automatically cleanses prescription and targeting data for PDRP Opt-Out accounts. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically clears sales and targeting data fields on Product Metric records when an Account opts out of PDRP.
* Generates and populates unique External IDs for Product Metric records by concatenating Account and Product IDs.
* Generates and populates VID External IDs for Product Metric records.

Name: Scientific Exchange Request Form (SERF) Management
Description:
Manages the lifecycle and tracking of Scientific Exchange Request Forms (SERF). 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Identifies SERF records expiring within 30 days and sends automated email and custom notifications to the record owner.
* Increments the number of SERFs on an Account when a Veeva Call with a 'Scientific Exchange' activity type is submitted.

Name: Medical Inquiry Management
Description:
Automates notifications and field updates for Medical Inquiry records. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically creates an iPad Alert for the inquiry owner when a Medical Inquiry is closed.
* Populates standard Email and Phone Number fields from the related Account when a Medical Inquiry is submitted with a 'Speak to Medical' delivery method.

Name: Sample Order Management
Description:
Automates notifications for specific sample order transactions. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Sends automated email notifications when a new sample order is created for specific products and regions (e.g., AMVUTTRA Syringe in Germany).

Name: Approval Process Management
Description:
Provides custom interfaces and dashboards for managing Salesforce approval requests. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Displays a custom 'Items to Approve' dashboard aggregating pending approval requests for the current user.
* Provides a custom interface to override standard approval UI, allowing users to approve or reject records with custom comments.
* Implements specialized approval and rejection overrides for Veeva EM Event records.

Name: Experience Cloud Authentication & Registration
Description:
Manages user authentication, self-registration, and profile management for Salesforce Experience Cloud sites. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Provides a custom login form and handles secure authentication.
* Provides a configurable self-registration form that creates portal users and captures dynamic user data.
* Provides a custom 'Forgot Password' interface to trigger password reset emails.
* Allows authenticated portal users to view and update their personal profile details and change their password.
* Redirects users to appropriate start pages based on their authentication status and target destination.

Name: Experience Cloud Error & Maintenance Pages
Description:
Provides custom error and maintenance landing pages for Salesforce Sites and Experience Cloud. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Displays a custom '404 Page Not Found' error page for invalid URLs.
* Displays a 'Bandwidth Limit Exceeded' message when site limits are reached.
* Displays a standard 'In Maintenance' or 'Under Construction' landing page during site updates.
* Displays dynamic error messages and warning icons for general exceptions.

Name: Salesforce Standard Page Redirects & Layouts
Description:
Manages standard page redirects and layout templates for Salesforce Communities and standard objects. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically redirects users to standard Salesforce Ideas and Answers home pages.
* Provides a layout template for Experience Cloud sites that disables default headers and sidebars.
* Renders the standard record detail view for Tasks, displaying all fields and related lists.

Name: Customer Survey & Feedback Management
Description:
Collects and manages customer feedback through Salesforce Surveys and automated follow-ups. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Presents Net Promoter Score (NPS) and customer satisfaction rating questions with open-ended text fields.
* Collects feedback from healthcare partners regarding their experience with Health System Directors and Medical Outcomes Science Liaisons.
* Resends survey invitation emails to contacts via automated flows.
* Triggers follow-up interview email alerts for specific contact consent records.

Name: Veeva CRM External Component Embedding
Description:
Embeds external Veeva CRM functionality into Salesforce. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Handles authentication and dynamic loading of AngularJS-based resources from Veeva servers.
* Renders specific application features, such as Call Reports, within the Salesforce interface.

Name: MC Cycle Detail Group Management
Description:
Automates the population of Detail Group information on MC Cycle Products. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically populates the Detail Group field with the product's ID when the associated product is a 'Detail Group'.

Name: Clinical Trial Site Alignment
Description:
Automates the alignment of Clinical Trial records with Account sites. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically updates the Clinical Trial Site lookup field by searching for an Account record with a matching Site Number.

Name: HCP Lead Rank Management
Description:
Automates the population of external identifiers for HCP Lead Rank records. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically updates the External ID field on HCP Lead Rank records by copying the Network External ID from the related HCP Account.

Name: Account Purchase Notification
Description:
Automates email notifications for first product purchases and cancellations. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Triggers automated email alerts when 'First Shipment' date fields for specific products are updated on an Account record.

Name: Zenflow Integration Flag Management
Description:
Automates the updating of Zenflow integration flags on Account records. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically updates the Zenflow Integration Flag on the Primary Parent Account when a Professional record type Account has its flag set to true.

Name: Account Name Modification Control
Description:
Enforces data governance by restricting modifications to Account name fields. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Prevents non-System Administrators from modifying Account name fields (Name, FirstName, LastName, etc.) for specific record types.

Name: Legitimate Lead Development Tracking
Description:
Automates the tracking of modifications to Legitimate Lead Development processes. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically updates the Legit Lead Modified Date field with the current date whenever the Legit Lead Development Process field is modified.

Name: AlnylamConnect Task Routing
Description:
Automates the categorization of specific AlnylamConnect tasks. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically updates a Task's Record Type when it is created or updated with a specific subject related to new HCP requests.

Name: Patient and Survey Field Representative Assignment
Description:
Automates the assignment of field representatives to Patient and Survey records. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically assigns field representatives (BAE, RBD, FRD) to Patient records based on the associated Physician's zip code and drug program.
* Automatically assigns field representatives to Survey records by matching the associated Physician's zip code to territory alignments.

Name: Patient Activity Alert Generation
Description:
Automates the generation of alerts for new patient activities. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Automatically generates Veeva Alerts and associated User Actions when new Patient Activity records are created.

Name: On-Treatment Patient Calculation
Description:
Calculates and aggregates patient treatment statistics for prescribing organizations. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Calculates and updates the total number of 'on treatment' patients for related Account records based on patient status changes.

Name: External Data Synchronization Management
Description:
Manages the synchronization of data between Salesforce CRM and external systems, ensuring data consistency and maintaining integration logs. 

Discrete functionalities include:
* Synchronizes Task completions with external systems (e.g., MARS) via REST API.
* Performs one-way synchronization of external source data into Salesforce CRM records based on custom metadata mappings.
* Automatically cleans up and deletes outdated integration log records based on configurable retention periods.
